description.value: Thai Taste is a family-owned authentic Thai restaurant located in a commercial plaza on Vedder Road in Chilliwack. It serves dine-in and takeout and is also available through Skip the Dishes. Touring cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley would find it a convenient stop for a sit-down Thai meal or a quick takeout order.
